x-kubernetes-validations.message: a Sandbox name is at most 63 characters

template.description: A SandboxTemplate in the Sandbox's namespace. The controller reads it at every start, so changing it, or the template itself, applies from the next incarnation.

running.description: Whether the Sandbox has a Pod. Setting it starts a new incarnation; clearing it deletes the Pod and keeps the state PVC.

policySets.description: PolicySets in the Sandbox's namespace to bind its own ServiceAccount to, through one PolicyBinding the Sandbox owns. No Pod starts until every reader of that binding reports it applied.

sessionDefaults.description: What a new Session in the Sandbox starts with unless its request says otherwise. The Runner Gateway reads them; the controller does not.

setupScript.description: Run in the Session's directory before its harness starts.

bootstrap.description: A script the runner runs once before the Sandbox's first Session. The Runner Gateway reads it; the controller does not.

incarnation.description: The Sandbox's current Pod, while it has one.

sealedIncarnation.description: The UID of the last incarnation whose runner sealed every Session, kept after it stops. A runner that connected and is not this one has Sessions still to seal before the Sandbox stops or is deleted.

quiescedIncarnation.description: The settled name of `sealedIncarnation`; readers accept either.

items.description: A metav1.Condition. `Running` is the controller's: True once the Pod runs, otherwise False with a reason naming the state or what blocks it. `SessionsSealed` is set on a deleting Sandbox: True once its runner sealed every Session and the ingress acknowledged each seal.
